name: Hulkepholis
sum: Hulkepholis is a goniopholidid neosuchian from the Early Cretaceous of southern England and eastern Spain.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Specimens from the Wadhurst Clay and Tunbridge Wells Sand (UK) and the Camarillas and Escucha formations (Spain).
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Buscalioni et al. 2013
